statement: Build a single-file, mobile-first website for Brew Lab, a cafe in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, that shows the menu with prices, opening hours and location, and lets visitors pre-order coffee for pickup.
audience: Local customers in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, who want to check the menu, hours and location, and pre-order coffee for pickup.
standards: Mobile-first layout that works on a phone screen without sideways scrolling
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step (CDN libraries allowed)
Content facts not supplied by the Requester appear as clearly marked placeholders, never invented
rules: The cafe name is Brew Lab and the area is Indiranagar, Bengaluru
Opening hours are 8am to 10pm, every day
Do not invent prices, menu items, address, phone numbers or photos
No online payment is built, since the brief does not ask for it
done_when: The page title and header show the name Brew Lab
A menu section lists drinks, each with a price, and any price or item not supplied is a visibly marked placeholder
The page states opening hours as 8am to 10pm, every day
A location section names Indiranagar, Bengaluru and includes a map or map link, with the street address marked as a placeholder if not supplied
A pre-order form lets a visitor choose menu items and quantities, enter a name and phone number, and pick a pickup time between 8am and 10pm, and shows an order summary on submit
The file has a viewport meta tag and mobile-first CSS (base styles for small screens, min-width media queries for larger ones)
The CSS defines a warm colour palette and the layout has no fixed widths that force horizontal scrolling at 375px
The site is one HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript and needs no build step
open_inputs: Street address and map pin for the Indiranagar location
Phone number or contact for the cafe
Where pre-orders should be delivered (email, WhatsApp, phone or other)
Brand colours, logo and photos, if any
